title: Chapter 132
text:
"What the f * ck, what kind of damage is that?"

"I was just grazed by the blast and died!"

"My experience is dropping like crazy!"

The first wave of players died valiantly, and the remaining players were shocked by the firepower of the Germinal Organization.

"The mission requirement is to deal the highest damage. As long as we can deal damage, it doesn't matter if we die. Go!"

SliceYouUp gritted his teeth.

The death penalty in Galaxy was not light. One would lose experience according to their level, and they could only revive ten times in six days. The next time they revived, the time would be extended, and they would be forced to go offline. However, for the prize pool mission, dying once or twice was worth it.

The Sky Territory had the same idea, and the other players followed suit. Although they were in a state of disunity, the thousands of people charging fearlessly gave the Germinal Organization soldiers a shock.

"Are these enemies here to die?!" Seiberle was shocked. He had never seen such a fearless army. They were like a pack of hungry wolves, ready to take a bite out of them even if they had to die.

Their aura was indeed terrifying, but their combat power … was too much.

"A disorderly mob. Since they want to die, let's grant them their wish!" Freier snorted and quickly ordered. Because there were mines in the forest, the armored vehicles did not move forward. The Germinal Organization troops used the armored vehicles as a base to counterattack, killing the players one by one.

"We can't beat them at all!"

"I've already died twice!"

The situation was completely one-sided. The players were being slaughtered, and they fell in droves. However, for the mission reward, they still fought back.

"I'll give them a surprise." Seiberle grinned. He looked at the enemies and felt that they were no threat at all. He could not help but want to attack.

Freier frowned. "Don't go too crazy. We're in a hurry."

"Humph, I've always been fast."

Seiberle jumped down from the armored vehicle, and with a spring of his legs, his strong physique allowed him to charge at the players like a cannonball. With one kick, he crushed a player's chest and stomped on him, sending him crashing into a tree and exploding into a cloud of blood and gore. The players' pistols were no threat to Seiberle. When they aimed, they would have already dodged. Even if they were hit, they would only deal single-digit damage.

Seiberle was like a tiger in a flock of sheep. The players retreated in panic, but they were chased down and killed without being able to fight back. Many of them threw out detection.

Seiberle?

Level:?

Attributes:?

Danger Level: Extremely Lethal

Another Extreme Fatality! All along, they had no concept of this level of danger. Only now did they know how big the gap was.

The battle prowess of a high-level figure was indeed terrifying.

"Black Phantom should be as strong as Seiberi, right?" This thought flashed through many players' minds.

Seiberae was bathed in blood like a ferocious beast. Because the scene was too realistic, even some of the more timid players were frightened. They hurriedly adjusted the game to neutral mode to reduce the gory scene. Some also turned on the recording function and recorded the scene of blood splattering everywhere.

A player who fell down in a panic was stepped on by Seiberi. Seiberi was in the mood to kill, and just as he was about to stomp on the player like a cockroach, a huge flower of blood suddenly burst out of his chest, and a hollow cavity appeared where his heart was.

Seiberi froze. His expression froze on his face, and he fell to the ground without a sound.

"Dead?"

"He was insta-killed!"

The players were bewildered. How did the enemy, who was like a blood-soaked demon god just a moment ago, kneel down in the blink of an eye?

Only then did the sound of a sniper rifle with the sound of electric current come from afar.

Jade Green Sky, SliceYouUp, and the players who were still alive all looked in the direction of the gunshot. They all remembered that it was where Black Phantom was lying in ambush.

This shot was done by Black Phantom!

"Such a powerful enemy was insta-killed by Black Phantom in one shot!"

The players gasped. Black Phantom's danger level was also Extreme Fatality, but his performance was much more 'lethal' than Seiberi's!

Black Phantom was obviously a higher level figure, and their strength was not on the same level. Thinking that the powerful Seiberi was insta-killed, the players' impression of Han Xiao suddenly became unfathomable.

He insta-killed someone just like that, how terrifying …

"Seiberi's aura is very strong. How could he be insta-killed?" Freier was shocked.

The power of this shot sounded familiar. A sniper who insta-killed a superhuman … It seemed like only one person could do that.

Freier's expression changed drastically.

"Blood Pact Society's Ghost-level Black Phantom! Damn it, why would a monster of this level come looking for trouble with us? Isn't he only doing bounties? "

In the past two months, Black Phantom had risen to fame in the underground world. His battle results were outstanding. He had killed 'Lightning Ember' Bai Jin and 'Wild Hound' Nordrick in one shot. Even the famous Invisible Demon had been hunted down by Black Phantom like a stray dog and had almost been killed. Black Phantom had become the most popular assassin in the Blood Pact Society, and his name had caused people to change their expressions.

The Germinal Organization had already ordered not to have any conflicts with Black Phantom. Even the organization was not willing to provoke such a troublesome super killer.

Freier had the intention to retreat. He hurriedly ordered, "Retreat!"

But it was too late!

Han Xiao activated the EMP that he had planted long ago, and all the armored vehicles within the effective range were paralyzed with a series of crackling noises. However, there were still a third of the vehicles that were not within the effective range of the EMP, and this included Freire's command vehicle.

Freier did not care about his troops and turned around to retreat.

"Once you're in my sight, don't even think about running."

Han Xiao's eyes were like ice. He activated another program. With his max level [Basic Programming], he had bound most of the mechanical control systems to the computer and could be remotely controlled.

Three hundred meters to the side of the Germinal Organization's troops, three metal discs were lying quietly in the soil. Suddenly, the discs split from the middle, and the mechanical parts folded to form a multi-barreled heavy machine gun. It became a small automatic battery, and the metal discs became the base of the battery. This was the small collapsible battery that Han Xiao had planted long ago. It was equipped with an automatic fire control system, and the ammunition was all armor-piercing high explosive bullets with a range of five hundred meters.

The small collapsible battery was one of the new blueprints that Han Xiao had created. Its original form was a fixed battery made from knowledge fusion. He had added folding technology and other miscellaneous blueprints to it. After hundreds of failures, he had created it himself. He had spent a lot of effort on it, but it was very practical. Similar things could be created by knowledge fusion, but creating it himself saved him a lot of experience.

As Han Xiao learned more and more blueprints, his ability to truly understand the use of knowledge became more and more obvious.

In the past two months, he had bought the remaining three basic knowledges from the factions he was on good terms with. [Basic Energy Conversion], [Basic Thermodynamics], and [Basic Acoustics]. He had learned all fifteen basic knowledges. In his previous life, it was very rare for a level 40 player to be able to collect all the basic knowledges. Some could not even learn all of them at max level.

The multi-barreled machine gun automatically aimed at the Germinal Organization's troops two hundred meters away. After one second of preheating, it spat out a torrential rain of hot steel. The trees that were in the way were destroyed, and the bullets instantly filled the Germinal Organization's armored vehicles with holes!

The flames were dazzling! Screams were heard!

The cost of a small collapsible battery was very high, and so was the ammunition. The battle of the Mechanic class was burning money, but once there was enough money, the Mechanic class could explode with overwhelming power. Only the rich Han Xiao could unleash the power of the Mechanic class without fear.

The firepower of the battery shocked the players, and they immediately became fanatical.

"So this is how the Mechanic class fights!"

"He can actually crush an entire army by himself!"

"So strong!"

Han Xiao was not idle either. He used his sniper rifle to shoot at the enemies one by one. Seeing the excited expressions of the players, he secretly smiled. Originally, there was no need to use the battery to deal with this small group of Germinal Organization troops, but in order to let the players see the destructive power of the Mechanic class, he spared no expense and successfully attracted the interest of the players.

Appearances were always misleading. When the players truly understood the cost of the Mechanic class, they would understand that there was a saying that could be used to describe this class.

"Using money to create happiness, no money to play with your * ss."

One of the main reasons why the Mechanic class was weak in the early stages was because they were not "always" poor!

The enemy was utterly defeated, and the players realized that this was the best opportunity to deal the final blow, so they excitedly rushed forward. Maple Moon also opened fire. Her sniper scope was equipped with electromagnetic scanning and auxiliary aiming. Basically, every shot was able to hit a Germinal Organization soldier. The more she fought, the more proficient she became.

Although the realism of the battle scene made Maple Moon a little uncomfortable, she had also experienced bloody scenes in other games, so she quickly adapted. The interface could also adjust the visual effects of the person to reduce the gore.

Han Xiao shot through Freier's knees with two shots, leaving him alive. He then switched to Red Falcon and quickly cleaned up the Germinal Organization soldiers. His killing efficiency was much higher than the players, one shot for each kill.

The gunshots stopped, and the battle was over. The players were still unsatisfied.

Freier, whose legs were shot through, did not care about the pain. He looked at the group of players in ragged clothes in shock. He had seen the battle very clearly. Many people were killed, but they appeared again.

'Are these people immortal?!'

Freier was dumbfounded.

Han Xiao, who was dressed in black, appeared. The noisy and excited players quieted down.

Han Xiao came in front of Freier, squatted down, and stared into Freier's shocked and angry eyes. He said lightly, "Where were you going?"

"Black Phantom, the Germinal Organization will never let you go!" Freier stared at him angrily.

"You said the opposite."

Han Xiao was expressionless. He lifted Freier's collar and walked into a small forest. Not long after, inhuman screams were heard.

The players shivered. Just from the sound, they could imagine how horrible Freier's treatment was.

Ten minutes later, the screams stopped. Han Xiao reappeared, but Freier was gone.

He took a piece of cloth and wiped the blood off his hands. He had already gotten the information he wanted. Seeing the players around him staring at him, he completed the prize-pool mission.

The players received the notification at the same time.

"[Hunting Germinal Organization] completed. Current prize pool: 520,000 experience."

"Damage Ranking: First – Maple Moon (Solo), Second – Jade Green Sky (Team), Third – SliceYouUp (Team), Fourth …"

"Prize-Pool experience will be distributed according to 30%, 25%, 20%, 15%, and 10%."

There was an uproar. The ranking was beyond everyone's expectations.

"He surpassed Sky Territory and Kill the World."

"He actually made the list as a solo damage dealer. Unbelievable!"

"Who is Maple Moon? A professional player? "

"I have never heard of this ID."
